meta.units: Speeds in Hammer units per second (u/s), distances in Hammer units, AUX/cloak in raw power units. Source citations are 'path:line' or 'path:start-end' relative to the repo root.
conventions: Values tagged "derived": true are worked out arithmetically from cited constants; the "formula" gives the working.
Class speeds below are BEFORE the active weapon's speed scale is applied. Effective in-game speed = class speed x weapon speed scale (see movement.weapon_speed_scale).
Where client and server code differ, both are recorded in notes.

spawn_side.value: info_player_attacker on even rounds, info_player_defender on odd rounds (falls back to info_player_start if the entity is missing)
info_player_defender on even rounds, info_player_attacker on odd rounds (falls back to info_player_start if the entity is missing)

teams_notes: No team-specific gameplay stat differences (health, speed, AUX, cloak, vision) were found; teams differ only in player models, HUD color, and attacker/defender spawn alternation.
Each class has 3 skins per team (NEO_SKIN_FIRST/SECOND/THIRD), chosen via the 'SetVariant' command. Source: src/game/shared/neo/neo_enums.h:3-9, src/game/server/neo/neo_player.cpp:453-482,510.
VIP and Juggernaut use a single team-independent model: models/player/vip.mdl and models/player/jgr.mdl. Source: src/game/server/neo/neo_model_manager.cpp:375,379,543-551.

classes.name: Recon

armor.note: No per-class armor or damage-reduction code found. Health is the only per-class durability stat.

crouch_walk_speed.formula: 200 x 0.75 (crouch) x 0.75 (walk); the two modifiers stack

jump_height.note: Jump velocity sqrt(2*800*54) = 293.94 u/s (1.5x the default 36-unit jump).

aux_sprint_drain_per_sec.note: Sprinting does not drain Recon AUX: the sprint device drain is cancelled for Recon while moving.

abilities.name: Thermoptic camouflage
abilities.summary: 13 power units of cloak, drains 1/s, recharges 0.55/s when uncloaked. See top-level 'cloak'.

abilities.name: Super jump
abilities.summary: Hold sprint and press jump to add a horizontal boost equal to your current max speed, on top of a normal jump. Costs 45 AUX. See top-level 'super_jump'.

abilities.name: Sprint without AUX drain
abilities.summary: Recon sprint does not drain AUX, and AUX keeps recharging at 2.5/s while sprinting. Stopping a sprint also skips the 0.5 AUX penalty that other classes pay.

abilities.name: No post-jump slowdown
abilities.summary: Recon is the only class that does not get the speed penalty after landing a jump.

notes: Bots assume a 72-unit maximum crouch-jump height for Recon. This is a navigation heuristic (jump height + stand/crouch hull difference), not a measured value. Source: src/game/shared/neo/neo_player_shared.h:117-167.

classes.name: Assault

armor.note: No per-class armor or damage-reduction code found.

aux_sprint_drain_per_sec.note: Only drains while horizontally moving. Each time sprint stops, an extra 0.5 AUX is taken.

abilities.name: Thermoptic camouflage
abilities.summary: 8 power units of cloak, drains 1/s, recharges 0.25/s when uncloaked.

notes: Assault is the default class for a freshly constructed player when the game mode forces no class. Source: src/game/server/neo/neo_player.cpp:573.
Assault sprint gives the largest sprint multiplier (1.6x), but Recon's higher base speed makes Recon sprint faster in absolute terms (270 vs 256 u/s).

classes.name: Support

armor.note: No armor or damage-reduction code found. The high HP is the only durability bonus. A knife backstab deals exactly 226 damage, MAX_HEALTH_FOR_CLASS[SUPPORT]+1, so it one-shots any class (src/game/shared/neo/weapons/weapon_knife.cpp:309-320).

sprint_speed.note: Support cannot sprint. NEO_SUPPORT_SPRINT_SPEED (216 = 160 x 1.35) exists but is commented 'Redundant, but for future usecases'.

aux_regen_per_sec.note: Falls to the default case (0). Support has no AUX consumers.

abilities.name: Thermal vision sees through smoke
abilities.summary: While thermal vision is on, the smoke fog screen overlay is suppressed. Support bots get line of sight through smoke.

notes: The code does not give Support any resistance or armor beyond its 225 HP.

classes.name: VIP
classes.selectable_note: Assigned by the VIP game mode, not from the class menu (the setclass command clamps to Recon..Support).

air_friction.note: Objective players (ghost carrier, VIP, Juggernaut) use sv_neo_airfriction_objective instead of sv_neo_airfriction (0).

standing_hull_height.note: Uses the Assault offsets (the macro's else-branch).

default_items.note: Loadout primary slot 0 is the SMAC.

notes: Player model: models/player/vip.mdl. Source: src/game/server/neo/neo_model_manager.cpp:375,543-546.
VIP can capture at a ghost cap point (counts like a ghost carrier). Source: src/game/shared/neo/neo_ghost_cap_point.cpp:240.

classes.name: Juggernaut
classes.selectable_note: You cannot spawn as Juggernaut. A player becomes the Juggernaut by holding +use on a neo_juggernaut entity for 5 s within 150 units (22500 squared). On death the player's next spawn class reverts.

armor.note: None found. Juggernaut does not bleed (DONT_BLEED) and cannot be gibbed.

sprint_speed.note: AMBIGUOUS. NEO_JUGGERNAUT_SPRINT_SPEED is defined as NEO_RECON_SPRINT_SPEED (270) and returned by GetSprintSpeed() (src/game/shared/neo/neo_player_shared.h:71; src/game/server/neo/neo_player.cpp:3929-3930), but the per-tick CalculateSpeed(), which sets max speed each PreThink, uses 160 x 1.6 = 256. 270 is only used by bot locomotion and by weapon Deploy's one-off SetMaxSpeed. 256 is likely the in-game value, but this is not verified in play.

default_items.note: The BALC can only be picked up by Juggernaut; grenade, ghost, MPN and others exclude Juggernaut.

abilities.name: Full AUX on activation
abilities.summary: AUX is set to 100 and health to 990 when the player becomes Juggernaut.

notes: On death, a neo_juggernaut entity respawns at the corpse position with a non-damaging explosion effect. Source: src/game/server/neo/neo_player.cpp:4100-4127; src/game/shared/neo/neo_juggernaut.cpp:111-118.
Juggernaut position is always networked to all clients (shown on the compass). Source: src/game/server/neo/neo_player.cpp:3946-3950.
Activating player is frozen (FL_FROZEN) while holding use; releasing +use or moving more than 150 units away cancels. Source: src/game/shared/neo/neo_juggernaut.cpp:174,183-196.
Player model: models/player/jgr.mdl. Uses distinct JGR56 footstep sounds. Source: src/game/server/neo/neo_model_manager.cpp:379; src/game/server/neo/neo_player.cpp:4129-4158.

speed_formula.value: speed = classNormSpeed x activeWeaponSpeedScale; x0.75 if crouched; x0.75 if walk held (stacks); x classSprintMod if sprinting (Recon 1.35; Assault/VIP/Juggernaut 1.6; Support 1.35 but cannot sprint); x0.6 if aiming; then max(speed, 55); then for non-Recon within 1.15 s of a jump: speed = max(75, speed x (1 - (1.15 - t) x 1.75)).
speed_formula.note: Server and client CalculateSpeed are identical.

backpedal_modifier.note: Backward (negative forward) input is scaled by 0.75 on the ground.

weapon_speed_scale.note: Multiplies the class speed while the weapon is the active weapon.

values.weapon: MPN45 (silenced; entity weapon_mpn, the loadout MPN45)

always_networked.note: The ghost carrier's position is sent to all clients for the beacon.

precomputed_jump_velocity.note: Used because g_bMovementOptimizations = true (gamemovement.cpp:74); assumes sv_gravity 800.

crouch_jump.value: If crouched or mid-duck, the jump sets vertical velocity to the jump value instead of adding to it. Standard Source behavior; no NEO-specific crouch-jump bonus found.

jump_buffer_convar.value: sv_neo_jumpbuffer (default 0, cheat) enables Quake-style jump buffering

bot_crouch_jump_heights.note: Theoretical values used by bot navigation only (jump height + stand/crouch hull difference).

formula.value: damage = (fallSpeed - 580) x (100 / (1024 - 580)) x sv_neo_falldmg_scale(0.25), about 0.0563 HP per u/s above 580

notes: Because of the 0.25 scale, landing at the nominal 'fatal' speed of 1024 u/s deals only about 25 damage. The damage is linear and uncapped above that.
The screen punch on hard landings is scaled to 0.1x of HL2DM. Source: src/game/shared/gamemovement.cpp:4241-4250.

allowed_when.value: alive, not frozen, on ground, not sprinting; pressing both lean keys cancels

notes: Lean distance is reduced if there is not enough free room (freeRoomForLean). Source: src/game/shared/neo/neo_predicted_viewmodel.cpp:411-414.
Left and right peek distances are asymmetric (7.5 vs 15). The convar comments say this matches original NT.

fallback_aim_fov_offset.note: Used only if the weapon is not a NEO weapon; otherwise the weapon script's iAimFOV is used.

silent_rule.value: While walking or aiming, footsteps are silent if speed <= 70% of the class run speed (or of crouch speed when ducked).

mechanic.value: In the air, only speed above the class run speed (with weapon scale) bleeds off: drop = overspeed x friction x frametime.

prone.note: No prone stance exists in the movement or player code.

aux_power.description: AUX is HL2 'suit power' (m_flSuitPower). In NEO it covers sprinting and the Recon super jump only. Cloak uses a separate pool (m_cloakPower).

sprint_drain_per_sec.note: 100 units in 20 s. No drain while horizontal velocity is 0. Recon is exempt while moving.

sprint_stop_penalty.formula: drain rate 5.0 x 0.1, taken when the sprint device is removed

regen_delay_sec.note: Recharge starts 0.5 s after all suit devices turn off.

notes: For Recon, SuitPower_RemoveDevice returns before updating m_flTimeAllSuitDevicesOff (src/game/server/hl2/hl2_player.cpp:2237-2239). Ending a sprint therefore does not restart the 0.5 s recharge delay for Recon. This is inferred from the code and not verified in play.

Client/server difference: on the server, the NEO 'no drain while stationary / Recon exempt' block runs only when sv_stickysprint is 0 (default 0, src/game/server/hl2/hl2_player.cpp:120,2046). The client always runs it (src/game/client/hl2mp/c_hl2mp_player.cpp:663-681). With the default setting the behavior matches.
Juggernaut's AUX is set to 100 on activation (src/game/server/neo/neo_player.cpp:4093).

cloak.name: Thermoptic camouflage (TOC)

drain_per_sec.note: Applied in whole-second steps: drain = elapsed x 1.0 once at least 1 s has passed since the last tick.

auto_off_threshold.note: Server turns cloak off when power <= 0.1 after a drain step.

what_breaks_it.value: Only running out of power, toggling it off, death, or respawn. No code was found that turns cloak off on firing, taking damage, or picking up the ghost.

activation_flash.note: A blue dynamic light (TE_TocFlash) sent to clients in PVS when cloak turns on.

firing_flash.note: Firing an unsuppressed weapon while cloaked triggers a short TOC flash. Suppressed weapons do not.

sound.value: NeoPlayer.ThermOpticOn / NeoPlayer.ThermOpticOff, sent by PAS plus players within 50 units

visibility_when_moving.value: A per-player 'TOC factor' (0..1, starts at 0.15) drives tint/refraction strength. Lower values are harder to spot. Each second, horizontal speed <= 20 u/s lowers it by 1.1; above that it rises by speed x 0.004 (for example +0.8/s at 200 u/s).

shadows.value: Cloaked players and their weapons cast no shadows.

vs_thermal_vision.value: With Support thermal vision on, a cloaked player is drawn with the normal (non-cloak) material but WITHOUT the thermal 'hot' override that uncloaked players get.

notes: Client/server difference: the server forbids cloak for Support and VIP (src/game/server/neo/neo_player.cpp:1263). The client prediction only blocks Support (src/game/client/neo/c_neo_player.cpp:484). VIP and Juggernaut have 0 cloak capacity, so they cannot cloak either way.
The client does not predict the gradual drain. It only zeroes power and turns cloak off when power would run out (src/game/client/neo/c_neo_player.cpp:1077-1099).
Bot cloak perception is simulated server-side (detection-bonus convars below). Bots always detect ghost carriers through cloak. Source: src/game/server/neo/neo_player.cpp:1411-1563.
Cheat convar sv_neo_infinite_cloak disables cloak drain (src/game/server/neo/neo_player.cpp:227,3803-3806).

value: holding at least one movement key

boost.value: Horizontal impulse along the eye-forward vector (reversed if holding back), magnitude = current max speed (GetPlayerMaxSpeed), x0.7071 if a strafe key is also held. Added on top of the normal jump.

notes: AUX is drained whenever IsAllowedToSuperJump passes, but the boost only applies if exactly one of forward/back is held (src/game/server/neo/neo_player.cpp:1148-1154). Jumping while sprinting with only strafe keys (or forward+back) costs 45 AUX and gives no boost. This is inferred from the code.

The eye-forward vector's z is zeroed without renormalizing (src/game/server/neo/neo_player.cpp:1568-1571), so looking up or down shrinks the horizontal boost by cos(pitch). This is inferred from the code.
The client predicts the same logic (src/game/client/neo/c_neo_player.cpp:1166-1177,1442-1464).

mechanics.value: Full-screen post-process using material dev/neo_nightvision. No entity-specific rendering changes found.

Full-screen post-process dev/neo_motionvision. Any model (excluding viewmodels) whose root velocity squared is > 0.25 (speed > 0.5 u/s) gets an extra pass with material dev/motion_model, highlighting moving objects, including cloaked players.

Full-screen post-process dev/neo_thermalvision. Uncloaked players, NPCs, ragdolls and gibs are drawn with dev/thermal_model (hot). The own viewmodel uses dev/thermal_weapon_model. Smoke fog overlay is disabled. Cloaked players are not drawn hot (see cloak.vs_thermal_vision).

resource_cost.note: No AUX or cloak drain tied to vision modes was found; vision appears to be free and unlimited.

sounds.value: NeoPlayer.VisionOn / NeoPlayer.VisionOff, heard only by the local player and in-eye spectators

rank_loadouts.note: A loadout slot unlocks when XP >= its price. XP_ANY (-255) means available even at negative XP. Slots are checked in order, and the first locked or empty slot ends the list. Names are display names from weapon_bits.h.
rank_loadouts.support_note: With build flag INCLUDE_WEP_PBK, PBK56 is added at 20 XP.

recon_detpack.value: The Recon detpack requires XP >= sv_neo_detpack_xp_limit (default 4; -1 = no requirement)

loadout_change_window_sec.note: After spawning, you can change loadout for sv_neo_time_alive_until_cant_change_loadout seconds, unless you have fired or dropped a weapon. Unlimited in idle, warmup and countdown.

notes: The loadout entry 'Mosok Silenced' (key mosokl) spawns entity weapon_m41s, which really is the suppressed variant (NEO_WEP_M41_S | NEO_WEP_SUPPRESSED, weapon_m41s.h:37), so players get what the label says. However, its WeaponInfo bit is NEO_WEP_M41_L (the scoped variant, weapon_m41l.h:37), and the unused 'Mosok Scoped' entry also points to weapon_m41s (weapon_bits.h:17-18). The metadata mismatch may affect bot weapon profiles; it does not affect the player loadout.

suicide_or_environment_death.note: Can go negative. Grenade kills with no attacker are excluded.

kill_assist.note: Goes to the first non-killer player who dealt >= 50% of the victim's max health.

round_win.note: Every player on the winning team.

ghost_capture_or_vip_escape.note: With sv_neo_cap_reward = 0 (default), each winning player who is alive (or all, if sv_neo_cap_reward_dead = 1) is raised to the next rank threshold (0/4/10/20), or +1 if already Lieutenant. This replaces the +1 round-win XP. A non-zero sv_neo_cap_reward gives that flat amount instead.

ctg_vip_win_without_capture.value: +1 extra for surviving (sv_neo_survivor_bonus = 1), +1 extra for the ghost carrier (sv_neo_ghost_carrier_bonus = 1)

cap_prevention_suicide.value: If the last alive player of a team suicides while the enemy holds the ghost, the enemy team is awarded the capture reward (sv_neo_suicide_prevent_cap_punish = 1).

paused.value: No XP or death changes while paused.

negative_floor.value: Penalties applied with bAllowNegativeScore = false cannot take XP below 0. Kill, teamkill and suicide penalties pass true, so XP can go negative ('Rankless Dog').

soft_suicide.value: SoftSuicide refunds the -1 XP and the frag (used for non-punitive suicides).

preround_freeze.value: Players spawning during pre-round freeze get FL_GODMODE and NEO_FL_FREEZETIME (movement frozen, can look around). Both are removed when the round leaves freeze/post-round.

tdm_dm_spawn_protection.value: In TDM and DM, damage is scaled to 0 for the first 5 s alive, until the player fires or drops a weapon.

blast_protection_sec.note: HL2MP slam protection: DMG_BLAST is ignored for 0.5 s after spawn point selection.

warmup_godmode.value: sv_neo_warmup_godmode (default 0): no damage during idle, warmup, countdown and pause

mirror_team_damage.value: During the first sv_neo_mirror_teamdamage_duration (7 s) of a live round, team damage is mirrored to the attacker x sv_neo_mirror_teamdamage_multiplier (2 in release builds, 0 in DEBUG builds). The victim takes no damage (sv_neo_mirror_teamdamage_immunity = 1).

class_change.value: Class changes apply immediately when dead, during pre-round freeze (before firing or dropping), in idle/warmup/countdown, or in DM/TDM within sv_neo_dm_max_class_dur (10 s) of spawning. Otherwise they are queued for the next spawn.

class_limits.value: sv_neo_class_limit_recon/assault/support (default -1 = unlimited, 0 = banned). If the requested class is full, the player gets the first non-full class; if all are full, no change.

notes: The player code applies no extra headshot multiplier (sk_player_head = 1). Headshot damage may come from weapon script data, which was not investigated here.
sv_neo_hitboxgroup_pen (default 0): when it is on, limb hits are re-traced against the head, chest and stomach. Source: src/game/shared/neo/neo_player_shared.cpp:858,902-924.
